title: EU Commission again rebukes Temu over failure to stop illegal product sales, exposing Chinese giant to another hefty fine
lede: Temu failed to take sufficient action to stop illegal or unsafe products being put on sale, the EU Commission has found. It comes as part of a probe into the company's compliance with the Digital Services Act. The Chinese shopping website has disputed the latest findings.
